**Context:** Ran the doctor-plus maintenance pass (first full run of the new version), investigated a session-start backup hook error, had Codex review the skill and hook changes, and trimmed memory bloat.

**Key Exchanges:**
- Session-start hook reported 3 `daily-backup` errors (`manifest-unmanaged:_to_delete`). Cause: the `_to_delete` folder wasn't on the backup list. A closeout session added it at 15:35. A test run at 15:36 and the real 16:14 backup both ended with 0 errors.
- Doctor-plus results: `claude doctor` clean. Of the old problems from 10-11, 3 are fixed and 2 remained (an old git stash, and a "hold until 11-02" line in 4 map files that goes stale Monday). 5 of 6 checks passed. The one flag was 2 long retired-Windows-laptop lines loaded every session.
- Running doctor-plus exposed a bug in its own step 1 (it picked the wrong old report). Fixed.
- Codex reviewed the hook commit and the skill-repo diff and raised 8 points. 5 were fixed:
  - The 8-day staleness check rounded down, so a log almost 9 days old still passed.
  - A late weekly run on Tuesday gave a false warning about itself.
  - The skill size count wrongly included hand-start-only skills. It is now 53 skills, 24,936 characters.
  - The tests missed the 8-day edge, a missing log, and a hook that prints nothing. All 27 tests now pass.
  - The hook message said "never" for a missing file. It now says "missing or unreadable".
- Report: `~/DEV/docs/handoffs/2026-10-30-doctor-plus.md`

**Decisions Made:**
- Kept on purpose: the 8-day grace time, a hand run counting as a run, and the shared handling of a job that has not run yet.
- The user chose option 1: shorten the 2 long Windows lines and delete the old stash. Rationale: low cost, nothing lost, since the memory files keep the details and the stash was obsolete.
  - Lines were shortened by cutting trigger text and keeping the links. The memory list went from 9,884 to 9,726 characters, saving about 160 rather than the 470 estimated.
  - The stash held only an extra copy of the dcg guard removed on 10-11. No stash is left.
  - Both changes were pushed and added to the report.

**Lessons Learned:**
- A test run of a real job can leave a note (`backup-dryrun-only`) that stays until the real scheduled run clears it. Commit first, then confirm after the real run.
- Savings estimates from trimming were overstated. Cutting only trigger text while keeping links saved about a third of what was projected.
- The error log was empty when rechecked, but this session did not empty it. Something else cleared it between two checks, so the cause is unattributed.

**Action Items:**
- Mon 11-02 at 10:30 is the first real test of the weekly run. The cause of the missed Mon 10-26 run is still unknown.
- The "hold until 11-02" line in 4 map files will be out of date Monday and needs updating.
- Confirm doctor-plus is gone from the skill list. This couldn't be checked in the new session, though the size count no longer includes it.
- The backup list still names 27 folders that no longer exist. This is not an error, but it could be cleaned up.
- The shorter Windows lines take effect at the next session start.
